def min_time_to_watch_videos(n, m, video_sizes):
    video_sizes.sort()
    total_size = sum(video_sizes)
    max_download_time = max(video_sizes)
    min_time = 0

    for i in range(n):
        current_size = video_sizes[i]
        remaining_space = m - current_size
        remaining_videos_size = total_size - current_size
        remaining_videos_count = n - i - 1

            min_time += max(current_size, free_space_needed)
        else:
            min_time += current_size

    return min_time
